mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals rising consumer demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate revenues.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below its 12-month moving average while the signal is active, or if S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds above its 6-month moving average while the signal is active, or if S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is falsified.
